query: What do Google Pixel 3a XL owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: High end functionality without the high end price.. Got this phone primarily for the camera and photo quality. Phenomenal in most areas while a bit lacking in others. Still, a solid value and the last of the Pixels with built-in finger scanners.

Compared to Pixel 3XL. Basically Pixel 3 lite version like how iphone XR si to iphone X or samsung Galexy s10e is to Samsung S10, but at a more affordable price. Here are the list of differences compared to the Pixel 3xl (original). 1. Camera. Best camera at this price point Same rear facing camera. One of the best, if not the best smart phone cameras out there in the market. Camera hardware is toned down. If you use 3rd party camera apps you may not get HDR+ Takes a few seconds longer for post processing to finish; not an issue unless you take multiple pictures in quick session then try compare them There's no duel camera on the front. So no wide angle selfies Unlimited storage at high quality with Google Photos to cloud for 3 years 2.

Slight blemishes/scratches on the back (which is to be expected for a second hand phone so I can give that a pass). a bit of grime around the camera where a case used to be, but the worst was that the speakers on the bottom where caked with that yucky dirt stuff that gets in there. All of that really isn't a big deal, I can clean it myself, but when it's advertised as renewed I would like to see the quality of renewal to be... like new.
Best camera on a phone at any price. Best phone for the money and best camera on a phone at any price!

Very Impressed. As described, looks and works like new. I usually can only afford low end phones so I thought I would take a chance on a used mid-range phone. Battery lasts well over a day and the display is bright and clear with no burn-in. Can't wait to try the camera.

Reasonably priced, great battery life, quality camera. I had purchased the 3a xl, but first time was sent the wrong item. Returned the phone and received the correct one without a hassle, just took longer than expected. The phone comes packaged nicely and with a screen protector already installed. Cannot tell the phone has ever been used. The battery life is amazing. The phone itself has so many features which can become overwhelming. With that being said, it's surprising how long the battery life is. I can last about 2 days while still using several features all day long. The camera is probably the greatest feature of the phone. The phone was reasonably priced. Would reccommend purchasing.
great value. got this for my wife. way less $ than my iPhone and better features. great camera

Decent phone for gift. Bought the phone as a gift and their setup was easy. The box was questionable, but the phone came safe and sound. So far, the phone is running smoothly and the screen had no noticeable scratches. The battery seems good, it holds its charge for a long time. The cameras are working well for both photos and videos.

GOOGLE PIXEL series phones seek to resttitute those with "BLIND" fath in HOLLYWOOD or GREAT BRITAIN.. Perhaps there is a stigma against buying Motorola phones that I also heed.! But if you have never purchased a brand that has been on the market since 2000, starting with Google PIXEL is a rough climb. It will definitely cure you of using an activated phone as a digital camera! It may also cure you of downloading "any" ANDROID system to your "older" phones.
Great value for money. Camera is one of the best mobile available. Great value for money.
Great turnaround, fantastic phone .... Great product, good shipping time, love how big it is. I bought it for the camera quality... it is awesome

Amazing gem at an awesome price!. Amazing camera and fast performance. It came boxed with adapter, cord, and a SD card key. I purchased the clear case separately from Amazon. It's all pictured above along with some pictures I took with the phone in my Barber shop. LOVE IT!

Missing parts. My Google Pixel 3a XL was missing the adapter to transfer data from my previous phone to the Pixel (which I confirmed should be included by watching unboxing videos and it is listed as what should be included in the instruction booklet). When using the phone the lock screen came up randomly when actively using the phone, which was annoying and Google has no solution. I requested a replacement. The replacement was also missing the adapter and was missing all of the instruction booklets. Both phones were bought new on Amazon and both had missing parts!

Works well, great software updates, decent price. I've only had the phone one week and already there were two updates released. That's a big plus. The renewed phone came with a crappy charger, so I purchased a replacement PD (power delivery) USB charger that charges the phone fast. Camera is great, phone looks new. Get yourself a decent charger. I'll be getting a case as well for those unintended drops. Would purchase again.
Quality phone, but the pictures are the best!. The pictures are beautiful

Good value with cavet. This was a very decent value on a refurbished Pixel 3A XL. The phone came with a generic USB A to USB C charger rather than the USB C to USB C the non-refurbished new devices have. This will work but will take 50% longer to charge the device. Other than that it appears to work well. The Camera, Bluetooth, etc all appear to be operational. My kiddo is pleased.

Great phone, great price.. Bought this phone when the Pixel5 came out. It is not 5g. But it works well for me and has a great camera. I used my Pixel2 for three+ years before upgrading. I am not a power user, so I do not need to pay 3-5 times as much for the newest phones. Get this phone if you are looking for a light, robust phone that always works. Is plentyloud. Great battery life.

Not bad for a used device. Accepting the discount for the previously used device, functionally the phone is quite nice. It was not without issues; namely some burn in on the display, which indicated the prior user played a lot of cookie-jam. Also soon after my usage I identified a dead pixel, which is annoying, but for my day-to-day existence doesn't really bother me. Otherwise it is a handsomely appointed device with a great battery life, strong wifi calling, Great Camera, and is every bit the pocket tablet. And more affordable than a brand new device.

This is the best phone I've ever owned. This is actually our 3rd Pixel 3A XL in the household. I got one, my wife wanted one, our son wanted one. It takes the best pictures of any phone I've ever had and my only gripe about it is that there's a bit of a lag when trying to unlock it, rotate it, open the camera, and pop into portrait mode when my kids are doing something adorable. It's otherwise nearly perfect. Pros: no stupid notch or pinhole in the screen, fingerprint reader (located on the rear) works great, screen is fantastic, photos are amazing, custom ROMs are fully supported Cons: small internal storage size and no expansion slot Another con, which is a stock Android issue, is that you can't get rid of the Google search bar on every screen and you can't change the search provider. Hence, the custom ROM.
GOOD INEXPENSIVE. Fast processor. Good screen. Reasonable Fingerprint reader. Good camera.
